claim_limits: This was a local standalone scalar calculation, not a hosted calculation.

It independently selected a Decimal200 candidate; it is not a certified interval proof of the binary768 argmax.
The same-precision C++ assertion is only a consistency check, and the hosted Python Decimal256 full replay remains the cross-language acceptance oracle.
